reception: The citation record is mostly brief: auto-vectorization papers list the framework among SLP extensions when surveying the landscape, and systems such as Parsimony and DynVec cite it as an example of the genre. The engaged citations are positional — work on hybrid slice selection for SLP, on retrofitting control-flow graphs in LLVM IR for auto-vectorization, and the compiler-construction paper If-Convert as Early as You Must each set their designs against its predicate-based approach. The paper has entered the frame of reference for control-flow vectorization; whether Predicated SSA itself is taken up is a question the early record does not answer. Evaluated artifacts accompany the paper at the Zenodo archive.
